item.title: The Institutional Mutation That Changed Everything
item.description: Why Europe’s rise wasn’t about genius or geography — it was about building the world’s first system that rewarded saying ‘I was wrong.’

item.title: The Light That Changed the World: The Story of the Enlightenment
